description: The rpgdotexe night: builds each Feature of one Epic, blockers first, like `night-shift.py <epic>`.

inputs.name: epic
inputs.label: Epic
inputs.description: The issue number of the Epic to build, as in night-shift.py <epic>.

nodes.label: Night report
nodes.command:
# The report of the night, as STATUS.md in the worktree and in the log.
mkdir -p .build/night
{
	printf '# The night: %s\n\n' "{{features.outcome}}"
	printf 'Features: %s done, %s failed, %s blocked, %s waiting.\n\n' "{{features.done_count}}" "{{features.failed_count}}" "{{features.blocked_count}}" "{{features.waiting_count}}"
	printf '%s\n\n' "{{features.summary}}"
	printf 'Your open pull requests, to read in the morning:\n\n'
	gh pr list --state open --author @me --json number,title,url --jq '.[] | "- #\(.number) \(.title) \(.url)"' || true
} | tee .build/night/STATUS.md
